Definition: of Chaldee origin (compare H1004 and H2617); house of kindness; Beth-esda, a pool in Jerusalem:--Bethesda.
BiblicalUsage: Bethesda — house of kindness, a pool in Jerusalem — it shows up only once, in John 5:2.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Bethesda shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
